kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

lines.say: Good morning. If you woke up worried, this is for you.
lines.small: If you woke up worried, this is for you.

lines.say: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee;
lines.big: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee;

lines.say: yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness. Isaiah forty one, verse ten.
lines.big: yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

lines.say: He said he'd hold you up. That means you don't have to hold it all together.
lines.big: He said he'd hold you up. That means you don't have to hold it all together.

lines.say: Lord, hold me up today with your hand. Take this fear. In Jesus' name, amen.
